description: Batch 1L-C1a Production Root Journeys & Accessibility Acceptance Manifest (Issue #40, Refs #40, #34)

criteriaMapping.AC40-1: Language choice before connect, OS locale sync, accessibility and formal guards; per-criterion case mapping with explicit responsible layers and visible unrun native residuals
criteriaMapping.AC40-2: Demo connect, session phase, live PIDs, and failure handling; negative control suite for keys, placeholders, meaning, malformed JSON, truncated report, and unexpected skips
criteriaMapping.AC40-3: Telemetry recording, session completion, history, replay, en/zh routes and recovery; zero extra permission, scan, or vehicle requests caused by locale changes
criteriaMapping.AC40-4: Export canonical CSV/JSON, gate settling, reopen; capture child exits, SDK, environment, test outcomes, and artifact hashes
criteriaMapping.AC40-5: Clean UI disconnect and post-disconnect quiescent transport; reviewer inspection of copy and accessibility artifacts while preserving frozen canonical exports

cases.qualifiedTestName: Batch 1L-C1a: Production Root Journey Acceptance [C01] Unconnected Language: real entry reachable before connection, bidirectional en/zh switch with zero extra requests
Batch 1L-C1a: Production Root Journey Acceptance [C02] Demo to Dashboard/PID/DTC: real Demo connect, session connected, live PIDs, read-only DTC
Batch 1L-C1a: Production Root Journey Acceptance [C03] Recording to History to Replay: live recording collects values, stop settles, tile click opens exact session replay
Batch 1L-C1a: Production Root Journey Acceptance [C04] Export/Cancel/Reopen: real UI export CSV and JSON, byte-identical canonical contents, gate settles, reopen same session
Batch 1L-C1a: Production Root Journey Acceptance [C05] Real Disconnect: actually tap Disconnect, session/transport terminal, zero subsequent dispatch
Batch 1L-C1a: Production Root Journey Acceptance [C06] Permission and transport failure: refusal reasons rendered, stored failure does not re-prompt
Batch 1L-C1a: Production Root Journey Acceptance [C07] Formal language guard: recording and artifact-busy blocks switch, permits when idle
Batch 1L-C1a: Production Root Journey Acceptance [C08] Late result/route/dispose: covered-success and route currentness protect owner and feedback
Batch 1L-C1a: Production Accessibility Acceptance [C09.1] 320x640 portrait at 2.0x text scale: zero overflow, minimum touch targets, semantics, and PNG capture
Batch 1L-C1a: Production Accessibility Acceptance [C09.2] 568x320 landscape at 2.0x text scale: zero overflow and PNG capture
Batch 1L-C1a: Production Accessibility Acceptance [C09.3] Dialog kept open while rotating orientation and switching locale: zero crash and zero overflow
Batch 1L-C1a: Production Accessibility Acceptance [C09.4] Semantics inspection: key controls provide accessible labels and actions
